payload.body_they: {{Name}} wants what they contribute to mean something. They may care about making something beautiful, helping somebody understand an experience, giving shape to an idea, or contributing to something they believe matters. The complication is that meaningful work can make vague expectations easier to accept. Purpose does not replace clear terms. Their sensitivity and imagination need enough support, credit, authority, and structure that caring about the work does not become permission for everyone to keep asking for more.
